units.text: A Venus flytrap has no brain. Yet a touch can leave a fading memory.
units.phonemes: ɐ vˈiːnəs flˈaɪtɹæp hɐz nˈoʊ bɹˈeɪn. jˈɛt ɐ tˈʌtʃ kæn lˈiːv ɐ fˈeɪdɪŋ mˈɛmɚɹi.
units.interpretation: Input phonemes are inspectable pronunciation evidence, not subjective listening.

units.text: A brief bend of a sensitive hair can send an electrical signal through the trap while it stays open.
units.phonemes: ɐ bɹˈiːf bˈɛnd əvə sˈɛnsᵻtˌɪv hˈɛɹ kæn sˈɛnd ɐn ᵻlˈɛktɹɪkəl sˈɪɡnəl θɹuː ðə tɹˈæp wˌaɪl ɪt stˈeɪz ˈoʊpən.
units.interpretation: Input phonemes are inspectable pronunciation evidence, not subjective listening.

units.text: Alongside that signal, calcium rises inside the leaf’s cells.
units.phonemes: ɐlˈɔŋsaɪd ðæt sˈɪɡnəl, kˈælsiəm ɹˈaɪzᵻz ɪnsˈaɪd ðə lˈiːfs sˈɛlz.
units.interpretation: Input phonemes are inspectable pronunciation evidence, not subjective listening.

units.text: Then the calcium level falls. For a short time, part of that change remains.
units.phonemes: ðˈɛn ðə kˈælsiəm lˈɛvəl fˈɔːlz. fɚɹə ʃˈɔːɹt tˈaɪm, pˈɑːɹt ʌv ðæt tʃˈeɪndʒ ɹᵻmˈeɪnz.
units.interpretation: Input phonemes are inspectable pronunciation evidence, not subjective listening.

units.text: Another signal arriving soon enough raises the level further. If it reaches the level needed for closure, the trap can snap shut.
units.phonemes: ɐnˈʌðɚ sˈɪɡnəl ɚɹˈaɪvɪŋ sˈuːn ɪnˈʌf ɹˈeɪzᵻz ðə lˈɛvəl fˈɜːðɚ. ɪf ɪt ɹˈiːtʃᵻz ðə lˈɛvəl nˈiːdᵻd fɔːɹ klˈoʊʒɚ, ðə tɹˈæp kæn snˈæp ʃˈʌt.
units.interpretation: Input phonemes are inspectable pronunciation evidence, not subjective listening.

units.text: Wait too long, and the next signal may no longer reach that level.
units.phonemes: wˈeɪt tˈuː lˈɔŋ, ænd ðə nˈɛkst sˈɪɡnəl mˈeɪ nˌoʊ lˈɑːŋɡɚ ɹˈiːtʃ ðæt lˈɛvəl.
units.interpretation: Input phonemes are inspectable pronunciation evidence, not subjective listening.

units.text: Two signals don’t always mean two touches: one slower hair movement can produce both.
units.phonemes: tˈuː sˈɪɡnəlz dˈoʊnt ˈɔːlweɪz mˈiːn tˈuː tˈʌtʃᵻz: wˈʌn slˈoʊɚ hˈɛɹ mˈuːvmənt kæn pɹədˈuːs bˈoʊθ.
units.interpretation: Input phonemes are inspectable pronunciation evidence, not subjective listening.

units.text: Here, memory means retained information—a fading chemical state, not conscious recollection.
units.phonemes: hˈɪɹ, mˈɛmɚɹi mˈiːnz ɹᵻtˈeɪnd ˌɪnfɚmˈeɪʃən—ɐ fˈeɪdɪŋ kˈɛmɪkəl stˈeɪt, nˌɑːt kˈɑːnʃəs ɹˌɛkəlˈɛkʃən.
